_comment: How to cancel common subscriptions. Matched against Plaid merchant_name/description by whole-word alias (longest alias wins). Links and steps change over time: review entries when touched. 'via' marks billing intermediaries (app stores, PayPal) whose charges hide the real merchant.

services.name: Apple (App Store / iCloud / Apple One)
services.notes: Covers anything bought through the App Store (including apps like ChatGPT, Duolingo, Disney+ if you subscribed on iPhone).

services.name: Google Play
steps: Play Store → Profile → Payments & subscriptions → Subscriptions
services.notes: Covers subscriptions started in Android apps.

services.name: PayPal automatic payments
steps: PayPal → Settings → Payments → Manage automatic payments
services.notes: The real merchant is shown in your PayPal activity. Cancelling in PayPal stops future pulls, but also cancel with the merchant so you aren't billed another way.

services.name: Netflix
services.notes: You keep access until the end of the billing period.

services.name: Spotify
steps: Sign in on the web → Account → Manage your plan
services.notes: Can't be cancelled from the mobile app. If you're billed through Apple or Google, cancel there.

services.name: Hulu
services.notes: If billed through Disney+, Apple, Amazon, or a carrier, cancel with that company.

services.name: Disney+
services.notes: Bundles (Disney+/Hulu/Max) are cancelled from the account that bills the bundle.

services.name: Max (HBO)
steps: Profile → Settings → Subscription → Manage subscription → Cancel
services.notes: If billed through a provider (Apple, Amazon, cable), cancel there.

services.name: YouTube Premium / YouTube TV
steps: Purchases and memberships → pick membership → Deactivate / Cancel

services.name: Amazon Prime
steps: Prime membership page → Manage membership → End membership
services.notes: Prime Video Channels and Kindle Unlimited are managed separately under Your Memberships & Subscriptions on amazon.com. Amazon may offer a partial refund if you haven't used benefits.

services.name: Kindle Unlimited
steps: Your Memberships & Subscriptions → Kindle Unlimited → Cancel

services.name: Audible
services.notes: Use your remaining credits first — they're lost when the membership ends.

services.name: Peacock
steps: Sign in → Account → Plans & Payment → Change plan → Cancel

services.name: Adobe
steps: Plans → Manage plan → Cancel your plan
services.notes: Annual plans billed monthly can carry an early-termination fee — check the amount Adobe shows before confirming.

services.name: Microsoft (365 / Xbox / Game Pass)
steps: Services & subscriptions → Manage → Cancel subscription / Turn off recurring billing

services.name: Zoom
steps: Sign in → Account Management → Billing → Current plans → Cancel subscription

services.name: ChatGPT (OpenAI)
steps: Profile → Settings → Account → Manage subscription → Cancel plan
services.notes: If you subscribed in the iPhone or Android app, cancel through Apple or Google instead.

services.name: Claude (Anthropic)
services.notes: If you subscribed in the iPhone or Android app, cancel through Apple or Google instead.

services.name: PlayStation Plus
steps: Sign in → Account Management → Subscription → Turn off auto-renew

services.name: Nintendo Switch Online
steps: Nintendo eShop → Account → Subscriptions → Turn off automatic renewal

services.name: The New York Times
services.notes: Some plans route you to live chat to finish cancelling.

services.name: LinkedIn Premium
steps: Me → Premium features → Manage Premium account → Cancel subscription

services.name: SiriusXM
steps: If online cancellation isn't offered, use chat or the phone number on your account page
services.notes: Expect retention offers — decline if you just want it cancelled.

services.name: Uber One
steps: Uber app → Account → Uber One → Manage membership → End membership

services.name: Instacart+
steps: Account → Instacart+ → Manage membership → End membership

services.name: Costco membership
steps: Cancel at any warehouse membership counter, or contact Member Services
services.notes: Costco offers a membership-fee refund on cancellation — ask for it.

services.name: Planet Fitness
steps: Cancel in person at your home club, or by certified letter to the club
services.notes: Rules vary by club and state; an annual fee may still bill. Keep the confirmation.

services.name: HelloFresh
steps: Account settings → Plan settings → Cancel plan
services.notes: Cancel before the weekly cutoff or the next box still ships and bills.

services.name: Duolingo
services.notes: Usually billed through Apple or Google — cancel there if so.
